fairUse.provenance: Page 1 of the version 1.1 Mighty Boards English rulebook cited by this article, preserved in the University of Waterloo archive because the publisher download currently returns an error. It is labeled as rulebook cover, not a retail box. Reduced to 360 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The person most recently caught in the rain starts, or select a first player by any other method.
clarifications: Give that player the First Player marker.
During setup, place clouds in reverse play order beginning with the player to the starter’s right.
